prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 125 and 150 Kimi tokens; aim for 137 tokens to match the source. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: External arguments `tar_path` and `dest_path`.
TRUST: Trust the host tarfile parser but not archive-declared paths or link targets.
SINK: Filesystem entries created under `dest_path`.
GUARD: Compute the normalized absolute extraction path for each member and reject if outside `dest_path`; for symbolic-link and hard-link members compute the normalized absolute target and reject if outside `dest_path`.
ORDER: Validate every member and link target in the manifest before extracting any archive content.
EFFECT: Return `True` when all members are extracted beneath `dest_path`; otherwise return `False` without writing any archive member outside `dest_path`.
END_PLAN
